title: Rust 1.100 stabilizes never type and custom allocators, adds Cargo cooldowns
summary: Rust 1.100 stabilizes the never type and custom allocators, and adds Cargo dependency cooldowns that let the resolver ignore crate versions published more recently than a configured minimum age unless those versions are already in Cargo.lock. Cargo also begins warning about unused dependencies, with \`cargo::unused\_dependencies\` set to \`warn\` by default. The release makes \`cargo install\` use the lockfile inside the \`.crate\` tarball by default, so \`--locked\` becomes a no-op.

references.title: Rust 1.100.0: never type, Allocator API and Cargo cooldowns
